Fields.Name: Current Grid ID
Fields.Description: Specify the current block ID in 8 digits. You can specify it using LOD0, 1, or 2. If there is an overlap in ranges, LOD0 takes precedence (e.g., m61_48_48_00 → 61484800, m61_24_24_01 → 61242401).

Fields.Name: Target LOD2: Grid Number 00
Fields.Description: Specify the target LOD2 block using four digits (e.g., m61_11_11_02 → 1111) (0: invalid value).
